article.title: Deduction only one mode of recovery.
article.content: The power to recover tax by deduction under the foregoing provisions of this Chapter shall be without prejudice to any other mode of recovery.
article.html:
202Deduction only one mode of recovery.

Section 202 · Chapter XVII · B.—Deduction at source · page 765 of the Act

The power to recover tax by deduction under the foregoing provisions of this Chapter shall be without prejudice to any other mode of recovery.
